hds-pipeline.label: HDS pipeline
hds-pipeline.description: HDS is a multi-commune SaaS platform for rural digital infrastructure in Sweden, live at hittadittsverige.se. This project is the development-pipeline-automation repo: the daemon (underseer.py) and the ad-hoc agents Patch talks to directly (overseer, ideas, planning). The pipeline-stage agents (features/acceptance/dev/testing-staging/integration-testing/reviewer/ux-ui) are managed by the daemon and are not spun up through this router.

test-wrapup.label: Wrap-up test
test-wrapup.description: Sandbox project for testing the SESSION.md handoff / wrap-up skill mechanism before rolling it out to real agents. Not part of the live HDS pipeline.
